title: Canonical constant-coefficient geometric adjunction and scalar direct-image mate
statement: Let $A,B$ be arbitrary commutative rings of universe $u$, let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital ring homomorphism, and let $f:T\to V$ be a morphism of schemes of universe $u$. Use the ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived categories of modules over the constant ring sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, with the canonical constant-section coefficient identifications [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. The coefficient maps are the actual constant-ring maps induced by $\varphi$ [def-sp-proetale-constant-coefficient-ring-map]. Write $S_W:D(W,A)\to D(W,B)$, $Rf_*^R:D(T,R)\to D(V,R)$ and $f_R^*:D(V,R)\to D(T,R)$, and let $\lambda_f:f_B^*S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_Tf_A^*$ be the canonical scalar/pullback comparison [def-sp-constant-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Define $f_R^*\dashv Rf_*^R$ for $R=A,B$ to be the canonical derived ringed adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] specialized to these constant rings and their fixed coefficient identifications; retain its unit and counit $\eta^R,e^R$. Define $\gamma_f:S_VRf_*^A\to Rf_*^BS_T$ as the mate of $\lambda_f$ under these two adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Explicitly, for $N\in D(T,A)$ its component is the composite $S_VRf_*^AN\xrightarrow{\eta^B}Rf_*^Bf_B^*S_VRf_*^AN\xrightarrow{Rf_*^B(\lambda_{f,Rf_*^AN})}Rf_*^BS_Tf_A^*Rf_*^AN\xrightarrow{Rf_*^BS_T(e^A_N)}Rf_*^BS_TN$. No finiteness, flatness, boundedness or properness assumption is imposed, and $\gamma_f$ is a natural transformation, with no invertibility assertion.
